annotations.title: Wheel spacer size and stud engagement

description: Use for "do I need spacers", "what spacer gets +35 wheels to +20", "is a 10 mm slip-on spacer safe". A spacer lowers the effective offset by its thickness. Returns the spacer needed for a target offset (and the nearest common size), the effective offset, track change, whether it is slip-on or bolt-on territory, and, with stud, stud_protrusion_mm and wheel_pad_thickness_mm, the slip-on thread-engagement check (≥ 1 × stud diameter and ≥ 6.5 turns).

stud_protrusion_mm.description: Stud length past the hub face.

wheel_pad_thickness_mm.description: Thickness of the wheel mounting pad.
